physicalNotes: No radius or mass of M48 is recorded: it is an extended star cluster, and its package frames it at 17.8 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), Hunt & Reffert's tidal radius estimate, a presentation value.

sources.position: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2548: RA_ICRS 123.45482046, DE_ICRS -5.7696807, the densest point of its members (epoch 2016.0) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
sources.distance: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2548: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 747.0835211 pc (16th to 84th percentile 746 to 748) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the cluster is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
